knownDifferences.description: A long-lived ReaderUIRuntime coordinator owns only the directory pair, book.open, TTS, and auto-page Pilots in ReaderUiStore.dispatch. ReaderReducer and ReaderEffects remain production owners for import, source switch, replace rules, RSS, reader.page.next/prev, and all seven Sync events while the shared runtime observes them in Shadow.
knownDifferences.exitCriteria: Route the covered events through ReaderUIRuntime as the authoritative reducer after rollback telemetry and parity gates are green.

knownDifferences.description: ReaderUIRuntime represents no active session as an absent optional value, while HarmonyOS ReaderUiState uses an empty string sentinel.
knownDifferences.exitCriteria: Unify the inactive-session representation in generated and native state contracts without compatibility coercion.
